dedupe_keys.name: population distribution estimates for the 2021 floods in belgium derived from facebook user activity

description: Dujardin and Linard release gridded population estimates for the 2021 European floods in Belgium’s Vesdre catchment. Zenodo lists public raster, table and figure archives under CC BY 4.0. Its linked GitHub repository documents an R workflow that calibrates Meta/Facebook population tiles against WorldPop demographic rasters and administrative geography; the repository code is MIT. The derived surfaces can test time-varying exposure estimates for flood evacuation or infrastructure-service simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the Vesdre flood population series. A limitation is that raw Meta Population Maps are licensed separately and are not redistributed, so the complete workflow cannot be reproduced from this archive alone. Facebook activity is a proxy for presence and may miss people with different device or platform use. The derived output grid size, temporal interval and uncertainty were not established from the landing page. No raster or restricted Meta input was downloaded, and the R code was not run.
